<ins>Six Gentlemen Decoction (六君子湯)</ins>
This is the Four Gentlemen Decoction (四君子湯) with added tangerine peel (陳皮) and pinellia (半夏), one and a half qian each. With the guiding herbs ginger (薑) and jujube (棗), decoct in water and take. <ins>Four Gentlemen Decoction (四君子湯)</ins>, <ins>Four Substances Decoction (四物湯)</ins>, and <ins>Modified Free and Easy Decoction (加味逍遙湯)</ins> (all are found under injury with bleeding, 傷損出血)
